note: LEANS LOW, NOT HIGH. The table holds 117 US screen positives in an 'unknown' column, outside both the IOPD and LOPD counts; if any were infantile onset the rate is higher. CROSS-CHECK on one published programme: Illinois, 3 infantile and 26 late onset among 684,290 infants screened to 2019-09-30 (Burton BK, Charrow J, Hoganson GE et al., 'Newborn Screening for Pompe Disease in Illinois: Experience with 684,290 Infants', Int J Neonatal Screen 2020;6(1):4, PMID 33073003, PMC7422983), 1 in 228,097, the same order. SOURCE CAVEAT: Colburn and Lapidus compiled several state rows from programme reports and public-records requests rather than from papers, and declare employment by odimm inc. and LapidusData Inc. and a fund that has received contributions from four Pompe developers (none of them BioMarin or Amicus). Screening is not the binding limit on the count: infantile onset presents with cardiomyopathy in the first months, so states without screening diagnose it clinically

With these four rows indication_layer.build should ask for prevalence, eligible_pct, penetration_peak_pct, discontinuation_pct and net_price_per_patient (the last two because Pombiliti's base model seeds no price or stopping rate at all). PREVALENCE: no free source gives US survival of infantile-onset patients to age 18 on enzyme therapy, so the under-18 stock cannot be built from the incidence above without inventing a survival curve; the ceiling, every case surviving, is 23 x 18 = 420, written here as context and not as a row. ELIGIBLE: ROSSELLA admits ERT-experienced children only after 'a clinical decline on their current rhGAA dose', and excludes invasive ventilation and untreated CRIM-negative infants; no free source gives those shares in the US. PRICE: CMS 2024 holds Pombiliti in Part B ($2.69mm, 13 beneficiaries) and Part D ($5.80mm, 13 beneficiaries), adults only, and the drug is dosed at 20 mg/kg, so an adult claim says nothing about a child's cost without an age and weight mix no free source gives. PENETRATION: no infantile-onset uptake of any enzyme therapy is reported separately by any filer. AND THE STUDY IS A SAFETY READOUT: 36 participants, open label, no control, primary outcome 'Proportion of subjects with infusion-associated reactions (IARs)' at 104 weeks, sites in Germany, Italy, the Netherlands, Taiwan, the UK and the US (registry, checked 2026-11-16). Pompe disease is an orphan indication, so PREA does not require it (Amicus FY2025 10-K 0001178879-26-000005, 'PREA does not apply to any drug for an indication' with orphan designation)
